title: A separable and asymptotic-preserving dynamical low-rank method for the Vlasov-Poisson-Fokker-Planck system
summary: We present a dynamical low-rank (DLR) method for the Vlasov-Poisson-Fokker-Planck (VPFP) system. Our main contributions are two-fold: (i) a conservative spatial discretization of the Fokker-Planck operator that factors into velocity-only and space-only components, enabling efficient low-rank projection, and (ii) a time discretization within the DLR framework that properly handles stiff collisions. We propose both first-order and second-order low-rank IMEX schemes. For the first-order scheme, we prove an asymptotic-preserving (AP) property when the field fluctuation is small. Numerical…
